title: A privileged role is held by a guest account

report.title: {Items.Count} guest {Plural(Items.Count, 'account holds', 'accounts hold')} a privileged role

messages.businessImpact: An account governed by another organisation's security controls holds administrative rights here. Their password policy, their multi-factor settings and their joiners and leavers process become yours.
remediation: Replace the guest assignment with an account in this tenant.
Where external administration is deliberate, make the assignment eligible and time bound.
